question.worked_solution:
First, we recall the results for the derivatives of the basic reciprocal hyperbolic functions:

$$
(\operatorname{sech}⁡x)^{′}=-\operatorname{sech}⁡x\operatorname{tanh}⁡x,\,(\operatorname{csch}⁡x)^{′}=-\operatorname{csch}⁡x\operatorname{coth}⁡x,\,(\operatorname{coth}⁡x)^{′}=-{csch}^{2}⁡x
$$

Differentiating the given function using these results, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(3\operatorname{csch}⁡x-\operatorname{coth}⁡x) \\  & =3\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{csch}⁡x)-\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{coth}⁡x) \\  & =-3\operatorname{csch}⁡x\operatorname{coth}⁡x-(-{csch}^{2}⁡x) \\  & =\operatorname{csch}⁡x(\operatorname{csch}⁡x-3\operatorname{coth}⁡x).\end{aligned}
$$
